messages:
alex: Support ticket: customer sees route cap 5k/day but throttled much earlier when requests hit accelerator pool. Console only shows route override. Propose small 'Why this limit' modal to show effective quota calc + routing affinity.
rina: +1. Keep it lightweight on list pages. Modal on click is fine.
sam: Backend: we can return flat fields: effective_limit, source_breakdown (account,route,burst), routing_preference (accelerator:0.8, standard:0.2), audit_id. Cache per (tenant,route,principal) short TTL.
leo: UX: badge text "Quota: 5k (effective: 3.2k)" and a modal header "Why this route is limited". Hide policy text by default.
infra-bot: feature-flag quota_affinity_preview created (off). Canary 10%.
alex: Owners: sam backend spike, rina UX mock, leo copy + small accessibility note. Plan: 3d spike, internal dogfood, then beta.
